consumer.use: Decide whether the corrected Outcome-Bound natural-sampling contract is semantically stable enough to justify a separate natural-activation proposal.

decision_target.question: Does the S1-R2 paper contract close S1-R1's natural-source-independence and canonical-legacy-identity defects without creating another post-observation selector or production/control surface?

intervention.name: canonical-identity plus fixed-slot naturalness gate
intervention.description: Normalize every Bureau candidate_task event through the deployed canonical identity rule before grouping, define Operator-Intake birth only at the normalized identity-first event, fix ordinal sequence before any naturalness judgment, then treat experiment causation or unprovable source independence as a slot-consuming rejection rather than a filter.

control_condition.description: Exactly three terminal predecessor controls: S1-R1 M1 natural-source independence was unfrozen; S1-R1 M2 legacy no-ID roots were not normalized through Bureau canonical identity before grouping; and PR #348 was merged after two decision-bound reviews were terminal but before a material REJECT had been reconciled.

treatment_condition.description: Exactly P01-P18 in sampling-cases.md, including legacy identity, later enrichment, supersession/dedup, manufactured and ambiguous source causation, independent source, timing interference, correction, D0, missed/result-known capture and event-id tie cases.

measurement.method: Freeze one author revision, then obtain two independent read-only exact-head reviews. Each reviewer must independently derive P01-P18 and attack M1/M2 plus selection, causation, timing, legacy identity and authority escapes. Before merge, reconcile every review job/receipt bound to the decision. No natural candidate observation is part of this measurement.
measurement.success: Both exact-head reviewers reproduce all P01-P18 author dispositions, material_sampling_contract_disagreement_count is zero, no reviewer requires a new production field/validator/service/control surface, and all decision-bound review jobs are terminal and explicitly reconciled before merge.
measurement.falsification: Any changed P01-P18 disposition, credible legacy-identity or natural-source-causation escape, fixed-slot filtering/backfill escape, unresolved contradictory review, unread terminal reviewer, head mismatch, or required new production/control surface rejects the author revision.

cost_metric.method: Record bounded elapsed runtime for both exact-head reviewer jobs as descriptive overhead; reviewer time is not an optimization target.

comparison.unit: terminal predecessor sampling/review-gate defect versus fixed S1-R2 paper case
comparability_constraints: control is exactly S1-R1 M1, S1-R1 M2, and the PR #348 review-reconciliation failure; none is natural evidence
treatment is exactly P01-P18 frozen before review
canonical identity normalization occurs before grouping or intake-birth classification
naturalness is evaluated only after an ordinal is fixed and can never skip or replace it
this paper experiment creates or consumes no Bureau natural-treatment candidate
confounders: paper cases cannot establish live StateStore observability
counterfactual source-independence evidence may be harder in natural work than in paper cases
two reviewers can share blind spots despite independent runs
paper stability does not estimate Outcome Case efficacy or prevalence

allowed: S1-R1 frozen method and terminal pre-activation rejection
deployed Bureau canonical candidate identity contract
PR #348 merge-gate incident with both terminal exact-head reviewer receipts
fixed S1-R2 method and P01-P18 cases
named read-only exact-head reviewer receipts and outputs

reviewed_exception.rationale: The successor is bounded to a paper-only repair of the two terminal S1-R1 sampling defects and creates no natural cohort or production integration.
